label: 01-None-Oriel
brief: Create a compact complete professional website for ORIEL, a fictional contemporary furniture studio. Invent its visual identity and make it attractive and useful. Include a furniture collection, studio information and an accessible inquiry form with honest local-only confirmation. Use a white theme. Mark examples as illustrative; do not invent testimonials, prices, awards or contact details. External images should use direct URLs, without downloading image files.
